name: Structured audit log
description: Adds a durable, queryable record of who changed what and when, independent of any single feature's own logic — generalizes the pattern reference-apps/nextjs-postgres-crud built ad hoc for tasks into a reusable pack. Needs a persistence layer already present — either the nextjs-postgres stack pack or the standalone db capability pack — but v1's requiresPacks is identity-based ("needs pack X"), not capability-based ("needs something providing persistence"), so that dependency cannot be machine-checked yet; see templates/pack.tpl.json's note on this.

inputs.name: retentionDays
inputs.description: How long audit rows are kept before an operator-run cleanup job may remove them. This pack does not run that job itself.

generatedArtifacts.description: Adds the audit_logs table (entity, entityId, userId, action, before, after, at).
recordAudit() helper — every mutation that needs a trail calls this instead of writing its own logging.

verification.description: Performs a create/update/delete through the app and asserts a matching audit_logs row exists with the correct before/after snapshot.

operationalEvidence.evidence: Audit rows are append-only from the application's perspective — there is no update/delete path exposed for audit_logs, so a compromised request handler cannot erase its own trail.
Every entry records which user and which request-level action produced it, giving a direct trace from a support/incident question back to the exact change.
